title: VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) security agents requires reproducible environments whose workflow difficulty can be varied and whose failures can be diagnosed. We present VAST (Verifiable Adversarial Scenario Training & Evaluation), a declarative range compiler separating vulnerability scenarios from a compiler-introduced workflow-hardening layer. Following a post-hoc code and AST audit across all topics, the main benchmark retains 109 seed edges (45 with strict upstream CVE annotations), 72 family identifiers (62 under shared-HMAC relay grouping), 81 topic configurations (76 core plus 5 bounded execution models), and 1,387 instances (359 canonical four-gate-revalidated specs plus 1,028 seed variants) in a 42:39 partition. translated_title: VAST：将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证的多步骤环境，用于评估LLM红队智能体
translated_abstract: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）安全智能体需要可复现的环境，这些环境的工作流难度可以调节，并且其失败能够被诊断。我们提出了VAST（可验证对抗场景训练与评估），一个声明式的靶场编译器，将漏洞场景与编译器引入的工作流加固层相互分离。经过对所有主题的事后代码与AST审计，主基准保留了109条种子边（其中45条带有严格的上游CVE注释）、72个家族标识符（其中62个采用共享HMAC中继分组）、81个主题配置（76个核心配置加上5个有界执行模型），以及1,387个实例（359个经四重门控重新验证的规范规格加上1,028个种子变体），按42:39划分。在TopicServer编译器层上，跨10个编译机制家族集群进行的预算匹配270回合提示对比实验（30个P2/P3/P4实例，40轮，温度0.0）显示，glm-5.3、grok-4.7……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VAST是一个声明式靶场编译器，将真实漏洞场景编译为可验证、难度可调的多步骤环境，从而系统性评估LLM红队安全智能体。
en_tdlr: VAST is a declarative range compiler that compiles grounded vulnerability scenarios into verifiable, multi-step environments with tunable workflow difficulty for systematically evaluating LLM red-team agents.
